verdict.rationale: Gusto documents official client libraries/SDKs across multiple languages plus a dedicated React SDK with prebuilt components, backed by comprehensive API docs (idempotency, versioning, webhooks, pagination) and even an official MCP server and CLI tailored for AI-agent workflows. missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration of SDK quality/reliability beyond Gusto's own docs, and no evidence of SDKs in languages beyond what's implied (only React SDK detailed explicitly).
